5000.label: $5K is plausible
5000.methodology: Weighted catalysts with a moderate hurdle: institutional demand and a friendlier macro backdrop can be enough even without full-blown QE.

10000.label: $10K needs a full-cycle bull case
10000.baseCase: $5K–$8K by end-2029; $10K requires multiple structural catalysts to compound.
10000.methodology: A much higher hurdle than $5K. Institutional ownership must become durable, regulation must normalize on-chain finance, macro must stop fighting risk assets, and Ethereum activity must translate into clear ETH demand/value capture.

5000.short: ETF inflows remain the strongest live signal.
5000.summary: Traditional capital is repeatedly allocating to ETH through regulated products.
5000.why: Persistent ETF inflows create marginal buy pressure and make ETH easier for large portfolios to own.
5000.greenTrigger: Positive flows persist for 1–3 months and continue through ETH pullbacks.
5000.redTrigger: A multi-week run of large ETF outflows or institutional de-risking.

10000.short: Promising, but $10K needs years of durable allocation.
10000.summary: The current ETF bid is encouraging, but a $1T+ ETH valuation likely needs ETH to become a standard institutional portfolio asset.
10000.why: $10K probably requires sustained multi-year ownership across ETFs, wealth platforms, pensions, corporate treasuries, and staking products—not just a strong quarter.
10000.greenTrigger: ETF AUM compounds for years, staking-enabled products become standard, and major allocators publicly adopt ETH.
10000.redTrigger: Flows prove cyclical, products stagnate, or BTC captures nearly all institutional crypto allocation.

5000.short: Sticky inflation + no QE = the main headwind.
5000.summary: The Fed is still focused on inflation and prefers rates over unconventional stimulus in normal conditions.
5000.why: ETH generally benefits when yields fall, the dollar weakens, and liquidity expands. The current Fed stance does not provide that full setup.
5000.greenTrigger: Hike risk fades, inflation trends lower, and markets begin pricing durable easing.
5000.redTrigger: Additional hikes, higher real yields, or renewed dollar strength.

10000.short: A $10K cycle is much easier with real global liquidity expansion.
10000.summary: Current monetary conditions are a major obstacle to the stretch thesis.
10000.why: A move toward $10K likely needs a sustained risk-on regime: lower real yields, easier dollar liquidity, or a genuine global easing cycle.
10000.greenTrigger: A multi-quarter easing cycle, falling real yields, weaker dollar, and expanding global liquidity.
10000.redTrigger: Structurally high real yields, renewed inflation, or repeated tightening cycles.

5000.short: Direction is better; the biggest pieces are not final.
5000.summary: SEC rulemaking is becoming more tailored to crypto, while market-structure legislation remains a major pending catalyst.
5000.why: Clear market structure lowers legal friction for exchanges, token issuance, custody, staking, and on-chain finance.
5000.greenTrigger: CLARITY or equivalent legislation advances and final SEC rules materially reduce uncertainty.
5000.redTrigger: Legislation fails and agency policy becomes materially more restrictive.

10000.short: $10K likely needs crypto rules to become boring infrastructure law.
10000.summary: The stretch case needs durable, bipartisan-enough rules that institutions can plan around for years.
10000.why: A $1T+ valuation becomes easier if tokenization, staking, custody, and DeFi are normal regulated activities rather than policy experiments.
10000.greenTrigger: Durable market-structure law plus workable final rules for custody, staking, tokenization, and on-chain finance.
10000.redTrigger: Policy reversals, fragmented jurisdiction, or restrictions that push major activity offshore.

5000.short: Ethereum rails keep moving closer to mainstream finance.
5000.summary: Stablecoins, tokenized assets, and DeFi remain one of Ethereum’s strongest structural adoption stories.
5000.why: If more financial assets live on Ethereum and its L2s, Ethereum becomes more important as settlement infrastructure.
5000.greenTrigger: Large regulated issuers launch meaningful tokenized funds, equities, credit, or payments on Ethereum rails.
5000.redTrigger: Activity migrates elsewhere without meaningful settlement or value capture for Ethereum.

10000.short: Adoption is not enough; ETH must capture the economics.
10000.summary: For $10K, Ethereum likely needs to become a dominant settlement layer for real financial assets at meaningful scale.
10000.why: Tokenization can justify a much larger valuation only if the activity creates recurring demand for ETH through settlement, collateral, staking, fees, or monetary premium.
10000.greenTrigger: Trillions in tokenized assets/stablecoins settle on Ethereum rails with clear ETH-denominated economic demand.
10000.redTrigger: L2 and app growth explodes while ETH fee burn, collateral demand, and settlement value remain weak.

5000.short: Yield-bearing ETH is becoming easier to package.
5000.summary: Staking strengthens the case for ETH as productive digital capital, especially when integrated into institutional products.
5000.why: Staking adds a native yield component and locks ETH into network security, reducing immediately liquid supply.
5000.greenTrigger: Staking-enabled products gain share and regulatory treatment becomes clearer.
5000.redTrigger: Risk-free yields stay far above staking yields or staking regulation deteriorates.

10000.short: $10K needs staking to become a mainstream institutional primitive.
10000.summary: The stretch thesis benefits if ETH is widely understood as productive collateral with native yield.
10000.why: Large-scale staking can reduce liquid float, deepen ETH’s monetary role, and make ownership economically distinct from non-yielding crypto assets.
10000.greenTrigger: Institutional staking becomes standard, participation grows safely, and ETH is widely used as collateral.
10000.redTrigger: Staking centralizes excessively, yields compress without offsetting demand, or regulation limits access.

5000.short: Scaling roadmap is progressing; execution risk remains.
5000.summary: Glamsterdam and later upgrades aim to improve throughput, wallet UX, and protocol efficiency.
5000.why: Successful upgrades make the network more useful and credible as long-term financial infrastructure.
5000.greenTrigger: Major testnets and mainnet upgrades ship cleanly with measurable capacity gains.
5000.redTrigger: Serious upgrade delays, instability, or persistent failure to improve value capture.

10000.short: The network must scale without weakening ETH value capture.
10000.summary: A $10K thesis assumes Ethereum can serve vastly more economic activity while preserving credible neutrality and security.
10000.why: Technical success has to include both throughput and a convincing economic relationship between L2 growth and ETH demand.
10000.greenTrigger: Roadmap milestones ship reliably, UX improves dramatically, and L2 settlement creates durable L1/ETH economics.
10000.redTrigger: Scaling fragments liquidity, value accrues elsewhere, or protocol complexity introduces repeated instability.

5000.short: Momentum improved, but $3K–$3.5K is the next real test.
5000.summary: Price has recovered strongly, but ETH still needs to reclaim higher levels before $5K becomes a near-term market target.
5000.why: A sustained break above prior resistance can attract momentum, re-risking, and broader crypto rotation into ETH.
5000.greenTrigger: ETH holds above $3K and then reclaims $3.5K on strong spot volume.
5000.redTrigger: ETH loses the recent breakout and ETF flows weaken simultaneously.

10000.short: $10K requires a new valuation regime, not just a rally.
10000.summary: The market has not yet demonstrated willingness to value ETH anywhere near the stretch target.
10000.why: A durable $10K path likely requires ETH to clear its old high, sustain price discovery, and attract broad capital rotation rather than short-lived leverage.
10000.greenTrigger: ETH clears $5K, consolidates above prior highs, and advances with strong spot/ETF demand rather than leverage alone.
10000.redTrigger: Repeated failure near old highs or a widening performance gap versus BTC and competing smart-contract assets.
